production_notes: Hold the corridor push-in for six seconds, then cut once to the warm bedside-lamp detail.
Use the original procedural ambience for subtle suspense; do not add horror stingers.
The title implies anticipation, not that a real incident occurred in this stock location.
Curated Pexels material must not be described as personally filmed.
Human visual and audio approval is required before scheduling.

checklist: Watch both MP4 masters and confirm the single corridor-to-room-detail cut feels intentional.
Inspect cover and contact sheet; confirm the long cover title is readable and centered.
Confirm source pages, creators, license evidence, and SHA-256 hashes in manifest.json.
Confirm 1080 x 1920, H.264, 9-second duration, and audio-stream checks passed.
Listen once with procedural suspense ambience and once silent; avoid an exaggerated horror tone.
Confirm there is no watermark, false personal-filming claim, or unlicensed external audio.
Add platform music natively and record the actual track in this file.
Verify caption, CTA, hashtags, cover, date, time zone, and preview before scheduling.
